subject.title: Add high-contrast mode for inactive displays

question: Should CodexBar accept this permanent opt-in AppKit workaround, and should the preference be limited to the Icon & percent style it currently affects?
rationale: The patch adds persisted settings and localization surface for a platform-specific rendering workaround; tests can verify mechanics, but maintainer intent is needed to accept that product and maintenance cost.

options.title: Accept narrow opt-in
options.body: Land the workaround after gating the preference to Icon & percent and preserving the current default rendering path.

options.title: Support every style
options.body: Require the high-contrast path and live proof to cover every menu bar style before exposing a general preference.

options.title: Decline the workaround
options.body: Keep the system-native rendering behavior and close the linked feature request without adding configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow opt-in
recommendation.body: Land the workaround after gating the preference to Icon & percent and preserving the current default rendering path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level UX and long-term AppKit maintenance decision for a new persisted preference.
